notes: Live hotfix after 0.8.6.5: preserves the confirmed Plada level-progression repair unchanged. Universal AUTO now clears stale legacy AI_TURNED_OFF on its own. When a visible hostile appears while a companion is still queued in PREBUFF/PREBUFF_FULL, target acquisition now cancels that out-of-combat queue and immediately seeds attack instead of waiting for ACTION_INVALID, fixing Dorna hanging on rebuff. Buff badges use a fresh window and derive the selected companion row from the actual non-PC party/faction sequence (including PRC familiar/summons) instead of a henchman-only index, then remain right-aligned beside that portrait row.
